title: CL-UZH at SemEval-2023 Task 10: Sexism Detection through Incremental Fine-Tuning and Multi-Task Learning with Label Descriptions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a multi-task learning model's ability to detect and categorize sexist language in social media posts (EDOS 2023 dataset) by framing the task as binary pairwise text classification using dataset identifiers and label descriptions.
